title: 第402章 番外：云初见雲初
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

零点的钟声一敲响，宋雲初的余光就瞥见窗外绽出了一片火树银花。

“姐，外面满天的烟花，咱们下楼去拍照吧！”

听到客厅那边传来表妹的呼喊声，宋雲初应道：“你先去，这烟花会放很久，我过二十分钟再下去。”

“姐你忙什么呢？除夕夜还放不下工作吗？”

“不是，我在盯着世界频道上的公告，看我们组出的这套限定锦衣有多受欢迎。”

宋雲初说话间，目光紧盯着公告上跳动的用户名。

上个月更新的新门派【飘渺宗】一上线，就有耐不住好奇心的玩家们充钱转职业，玩家们发现新门派的动作设计非常飘逸美观，难得夸起了策划组。

根据玩家们反馈，飘渺宗的动作设计是所有门派当中最好看的。

对此宋雲初一点都不意外。

飘渺真诀的招式有多好看，她在上一世就听过无数的夸奖了。

新门派搞定之后，就是新春锦衣的活动方案。

还是由她来设计，她几乎没有多想，就画出了玄色龙纹锦衣的设计图。

这款限定锦衣名为【龙游织锦】，细节和色彩方面经过美工的一次次优化，总算达到了她满意的程度。

锦衣的价格设定是保底充值3个648就能拿下，运气好的话不足千元也能抽到，但此次活动的重点并不是锦衣本身，而是锦衣可以召唤出来的包身特效【龙临天下】。

集齐十个特效碎片就能激活身上的特效，激活后的效果是周身有冰蓝色半透明的飞龙围绕，出场极度拉风，同时伴有足迹【千里江山】，玩家只要移动，脚下就会绽开水墨画般的山峦痕迹。

特效的价格是锦衣的十倍，此活动一出，如她预料般，世界频道一片骂声——

一个外观卖两万多，狗策划是不是这辈子没见过钱？

知道你们黑，但没想到你们吃相能这么难看，滚回家种地去吧。

哪个老板买了全套的给我见识一下？看更新公告上的预览图好像还不错。

狗策划能不能体谅一下平民的钱包？月入三千八，拿命往里搭。

而就在一片骂声中，全服公告跳出了一个接一个耀眼的用户名。

恭喜玩家【晓靖】在新春夺宝活动中抽中龙游织锦的全套特效。

恭喜玩家【饿到生啃骑手】在新春夺宝活动中抽中龙游织锦的全套特效。

恭喜玩家【一只寿司】在新春夺宝活动中抽中龙游织锦的全套特效。

恭喜XXX……

世界频道上依旧骂声不断，但这期间也夹杂了许多赞叹与好奇的声音——

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As soon as the clock struck zero o'clock, Song Yunchu caught a glimpse of a field of fire and flowers blooming outside the window from the corner of his eye.

"Sister, the sky is full of fireworks outside, let's go downstairs and take pictures!"

Hearing his cousin's shouts from the living room, Song Yunchu responded: "You go first. The fireworks will be set off for a long time. I won't go down in twenty minutes."

"Sister, what are you busy with? Can't you let go of work on New Year's Eve?"

"No, I'm watching the announcement on the World Channel to see how popular this limited set of brocade clothes we created is."

As Song Yunchu spoke, his eyes were fixed on the user name that was jumping on the announcement.

As soon as the new sect [Piaomiao Sect] updated last month went online, players who could not bear their curiosity paid money to change careers. Players found that the action design of the new sect was very elegant and beautiful, and it was rare for the planning team to praise it.

According to player feedback, the action design of Piao Miao Sect is the best among all sects.

Song Yunchu was not surprised at all.

She had heard countless compliments on how beautiful Piaomiao Zhenjue's moves were in her previous life.

After the new sect is settled, it’s time to plan activities for the New Year Jinyi.

It was up to her to design it. She drew the design of the black dragon-patterned brocade garment without much thought.

This limited-edition brocade garment is called [Longyou Brocade]. The details and colors have been optimized repeatedly by the artist, and finally reached her satisfaction.

The price of Jinyi is set to a guaranteed minimum recharge of 3 648 to get it. If you are lucky, you can get it for less than a thousand yuan. However, the focus of this event is not the Jinyi itself, but the body-covering special effect [Dragon in the World] that Jinyi can summon.

Collecting ten special effect fragments can activate the special effects on the body. The effect after activation is that the body is surrounded by ice-blue translucent flying dragons, which makes the appearance extremely attractive. At the same time, it is accompanied by footprints [Thousands of Miles of Rivers and Mountains]. As long as the player moves, traces of mountains like ink paintings will bloom under his feet.

The price of special effects is ten times that of Jinyi. As soon as this event came out, as she expected, the World Channel was full of curses——

One appearance sells for more than 20,000 yuan. Has the dog planner never seen money in his life?

I know you are evil, but I didn’t expect you to look so ugly when you eat. Go home and farm.

Which boss bought a complete set for me to see?The preview on the update announcement seems pretty good.

Can Dog Planner be considerate of civilian wallets?When the month reaches 3,800 yuan, take your life and go inside.

And in the midst of the scolding, the server-wide announcement popped up with dazzling usernames one after another.

Congratulations to the player [Xiao Jing] for winning the full set of special effects of Longyou Brocade in the New Year treasure hunting event.

Congratulations to the player [Hungry Rider] for winning the full set of special effects of Longyou Brocade in the New Year treasure hunting event.

Congratulations to the player [One Sushi] for winning the full set of special effects of Longyou Brocade in the New Year treasure hunt event.

Congratulations XXX…

There were still constant curses on the World Channel, but there were also many voices of admiration and curiosity mixed in during this period——
